ITEM 1 | Sliced meat piece with pinkish-red interior and grayish-brown seared outer edge, moist surface with slight sheen, roughly 7 cm by 4 cm footprint, about 1.5 cm thick, partially covered with green herb garnish and a brownish-green coating or sauce, sits at upper right of plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Green herb garnish of small loose leaves and thin stems, bright green, scattered over the meat and a few leaves lying on the plate beside it, footprint about 4 cm by 3 cm, very light and thin | 5
ITEM 3 | Brownish-green wet sauce or paste coating the upper part of the meat, glossy with slight sheen, spread unevenly over about 4 cm by 3 cm area, thin layer under 0.5 cm | 8
ITEM 4 | Two pieces of golden-brown toasted bread or crouton, cubed-to-wedge shape, crisp edges with light browning, dry matte surface with some crumb texture, one piece about 3.5 cm by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, the other about 4 cm by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sit side by side below the meat | 30
ITEM 5 | Second crouton-like piece, pale golden interior with darker browned crust on top, dry and crumbly edges, about 4 cm by 3 cm and 1.5 cm thick, placed directly beneath the first toasted piece | 25
